name: Email through Mailgun (lite)
description: Takes the mailgun provider id from the built-in tavi.mailgun: a signed inbound route in, the Messages API out, text only.

channels.label: Email (Mailgun lite)
channels.description: Email the agent through a Mailgun domain whose inbound route forwards to this connection.

settings.label: Sender address
settings.help: An address on the sending domain; tavi@<domain> when empty.

fields.label: API key
fields.help: Mailgun → API Security → a sending key for this domain.

fields.label: Webhook signing key
fields.help: Mailgun → Webhooks → HTTP webhook signing key.

channels.setupHelp: Add a Mailgun inbound route whose action forwards to this connection's webhook address (<public address>/hooks/<connection id>/inbound), and allow each sender's address in Allowed people. Text only: mail with attachments is not taken.
